description: This file implements a histogram data structure for CPU performance analysis, including initialization, value addition, and report generation functions.

methods.name: initHistogramsModule
methods.description: Initializes histogram bounds and lookup tables.

methods.name: histogramGetIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a value within histogram bounds.

methods.name: initHistogram
methods.description: Resets a histogram data structure with a given name.

methods.name: hsAdd
methods.description: Adds a new value to the histogram.

methods.name: hsReport
methods.description: Prepares a report of histogram data for analysis.
